instructions: This is a client-only React 19 + TypeScript + Vite app that plans multi-day hikes on the Speyside Way. Maps render with MapLibre GL; shared state lives in the zustand store in src/store.ts. There is no backend. Files under data/ are produced by the fetch pipeline in scripts/*.mjs (OpenStreetMap/Valhalla) or hand-curated. GeoJSON coordinates are always [longitude, latitude] order — flag swapped coordinates. Print output is controlled by print media rules in src/App.css.

rules.rule: GeoJSON and routing code must keep coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order; never swap to [latitude, longitude].
Shared UI state should go through the zustand store in src/store.ts rather than prop drilling or new React context.
